resolved.title: 定时器
resolved.problem_statement_md:
编写一个定时器程序，将秒数作为输入，输出剩余时间并倒数到0。
你需要输出每个数字，包括0。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]while Loop[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Create a timer program that will take the number of seconds as input, output the remaining time and countdown to 0.
You need to output every number, including 0.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
5

[b]Sample Input[/b]
5
4
3
2
1
0

[note]You can use -- decrement for shorter code.
[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 你可以使用 `--` 递减来实现更短的代码。
